## Services
- [General Construction & New Builds](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/general-construction): Complete residential and commercial construction from site planning and foundation through framing, systems, finishes, and handover.
- [Remodeling & Interior Construction](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/remodeling-interiors): Complete kitchen, bathroom, living-space, basement, and commercial interior remodeling with integrated lighting and building systems.
- [Plumbing & Water Systems](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/plumbing): Plumbing rough-ins, fixture installations, water-heating systems, and renovation coordination for residential and commercial properties.
- [HVAC & Air Conditioning Services](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/hvac): Heating, cooling, and indoor air quality solutions engineered for year-round comfort and maximum energy efficiency.
- [Licensed Electrical Services](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/electrical): Safe, reliable electrical solutions including 200A panel upgrades, rewiring, lighting, and surge protection for ultimate peace of mind.
- [Custom Solar Energy Systems](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/solar): Custom residential and commercial solar solutions with battery backup to save money, hedge against utility inflation, and power your home sustainably.
- [EV Charging Station Installation](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/ev-charging): Home and commercial Level 2 EV charging stations installed safely for convenience, rapid charging speeds, and long-term reliability.
- [Outdoor & Landscape Lighting](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/outdoor-lighting): Custom outdoor, pathway, facade, pool, and landscape lighting systems engineered with weatherproof brass fixtures, dusk-to-dawn sensors, and smart zone controls.
- [Security Camera & Surveillance Systems](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/security-cameras): Professional wired 4K security camera installations with 360° PTZ coverage, continuous local NVR recording, infrared night vision, and mobile app monitoring.
- [Smart Control Hub & Automation Systems](https://vixgeneralservices.com/services/smart-automation): Centralized smart controllers, Wi-Fi gateways, and NEMA 3R distribution panels offering seamless smartphone control, dimming, and automation.
